event.title: Prince Harry and Meghan Plan Extended Stay in the UK with Their Children
event.canonical_title: Prince Harry and Meghan Plan Extended Stay in the UK with Their Children
event.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle are set to return to the United Kingdom after living in the US for over six years. Reports indicate that they will reside in a private home outside London, and their children are expected to enroll in a British school. Buckingham Palace has confirmed the couple's move back to the UK.

timeline.title: Prince Harry and Meghan Plan Extended Stay in the UK with Their Children
timeline.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan are returning to the United Kingdom for an extended stay starting this fall. Their children, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet, have already enrolled in British schools and will begin classes in September. The couple will not resume their roles as working members of the royal family.
key_facts: Prince Harry and Meghan are returning to the UK for an extended stay.
Their children have enrolled in British schools starting in September.
The couple will not resume royal duties.
